meta.name: higgsfield-generate
meta.description:
Generate images/videos/3D assets/audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults:
GPT Image 2 for image/design/text, Seedance 2.0 for
video, Nano Banana 2/Lite/Pro for character/reference
images, Marketing Studio for ads, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio.
Use when: "generate an image", "make a video", "animate
this photo", "image-to-video", "edit/stylize/remix this
image", "reframe this video", "edit this video from a
sketch", "create a 3D model/GLB", "create a sound effect",
"make music", "text-to-audio", "create an ad", "make a UGC
video", "unboxing", "presenter video", "import product from
URL", or "analyze video virality". Supports generic generation,
workflows, Marketing Studio, and Virality Predictor.
Chain with higgsfield-soul-id for face/identity consistency.
NOT for: Soul training, brand systems/brandbooks (use
higgsfield-brandkit), photoshoots, cards, YouTube thumbnails
(use higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail), explainers (use
higgsfield-video-explainer), playable games/assets (use
higgsfield-game-generation), or TTS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一句话生成图片、视频、音频与3D资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要快速产出媒体素材但不想学专业工具
copy.tagline_en: Generate images, videos, audio, and 3D assets from text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce media assets quickly without learning professional tools

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以按你的要求用 Higgsfield AI 生成图片、视频、3D 模型、音效和音乐，并能分析视频的传播性。它会自动挑选合适的模型（如 GPT Image 2、Seedance 2.0），生成后把结果链接发给你。
howto.when: 当你说出“生成图片”“制作视频”“创建广告”等生成类请求，或要求“分析视频传播性”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用赛博朋克风格生成一张城市夜景图片
say.note: 调用 GPT Image 2 出图并附链接。

say.text: 把这张照片做成10秒视频
say.note: 需提供照片路径，会用 Seedance 2.0 生成。

say.text: 分析这个视频的传播潜力
say.note: 调用 Virality Predictor，返回分数报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Higgsfield AI to generate images, videos, 3D models, sound effects, and music on request, and analyze a video's virality. It picks a suitable default model (e.g., GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0) and returns the result URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "generate an image", "make a video", "create an ad", or similar generation requests, or request "analyze video virality".

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk-style city night image for me.
say_en.note: Calls GPT Image 2 and returns the image URL.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a 10-second video.
say_en.note: Uses Seedance 2.0 for image-to-video; requires the photo path.

say_en.text: Analyze the virality of this video.
say_en.note: Runs Virality Predictor and returns a score report.
